description: A satellite image map of a section of the Hortobágy Natura 2000 (N2K) site in Hungary, acquired on 2011-09-22 by Spot 5 at 2.5 m resolution, using a 1/2/3 band combination (false-colour infrared composite). The map features a large, irregular dark blue water body in the lower left, indicative of a lake or pond. The surrounding land cover is predominantly reddish-brown and greenish-brown, representing Pannonic steppe grasslands and potentially mixed agricultural land, consistent with autumnal dry vegetation appearance in an infrared composite. A prominent green polygonal outline delineates the boundary of the Natura 2000 protected area. A smaller, central green circular point of interest marker is visible within the steppe area.
